title: Keeps My Purses Dust Free
text: Keeps My Purses Dust Free. I am so happy with these clear bags! I can see what purse is inside, but they are kept dust free now! I am not using the hooks and hanging them up. Instead I have lined them up along the top shelf in my closet. It makes the closet look nicer and better organized while keeping my purses in better condition.

product_metadata.title: Dobures 10 Packs Dust Bags for Handbags, Clear Handbag Storage, Purse Storage Organizer for Closet, Purse Cover Hanging Closet Organizer with Zipper and Handles
features: 【Clear Storage Bags】These closet handbag storage bags with 3 sides clear transparent material, which is clear for easy identification, save your time without searching and digging to find your handbags or purses
【4 Sizes & 10 Pack】S*2 (10.3*4.4*12.6 inch ) , M*3 (11.9*7.5*15.4 inch ), L*3 (13.4*5.2*15.8 inch ), Xl*2 (14.8*8.1*17 inch ) meet your different storage needs.

【Dustproof & Breathable】The dust bags for handbags with 2 sides made of breathable non-woven material, keep your handbags clean. Smooth and durable zipper for better protect bags from dust, keep your purses be new and neat all the time.

【Portable Design】Portable handles design will help you easily hang the bag up to save space. We also provide 10 pcs of S hooks for you to hang the purse dust bags in your closet. You can fold it when not in use.
【Multi-functional】These storage bags can not only be used for bag storage, but also for other items like gloves, scarves, toys, makeups, etc. It can be stored in a closet, door, shelves, etc.
